## 🎉 What's New in v0.16.2

**Predictive heating now actually learns how each room behaves.**

---

## 🐛 Bug Fixes

### 🧠 The room model learns from real data

After a week live, no room had moved from the fallback controller to predictive control. The forecasts were 0.75–1.26 °C off two hours ahead, against a 0.3 °C limit.

The cause was that the model trusted its starting guesses far too much. Each new measurement nudged it by almost nothing, so after a week it still predicted about 0.4 °C per hour of cooling in rooms that were holding steady. That happens in rooms that get heat from their neighbours, for example.

The model now gives real measurements far more weight, so it settles on each room's behaviour within about a day.

**What you'll notice:**
- **Forecasts:** the predictive forecast sensors stop drifting downward over the next few days.
- **Switching:** rooms can switch from fallback to predictive control once their forecasts prove accurate.

**Upgrading:** existing rooms keep everything they have learned. On first start after the update they simply become open to new data again. Nothing needs reconfiguring.
